title: The theory so far covers only finite-dimensional Hilbert states

statements.text: Invariant set theory has so far been developed only for finite-dimensional Hilbert states. Its reading of continuous wavefunctions in spacetime, and so of wave-particle duality, and whether the modified field equations explain dark matter, remain to be worked out. The global geometry of the invariant set is unknown.

sources.quote: So far, IST has only been developed to describe finite-dimensional Hilbert States.
